The Defective Detective - Album 2: Serah Investigates

The Color of Rage

"This is the color of rage Red on the file, fire on the stage"

[Verse] Deep in the capital, neon scars Broken amps and rebel bars Rikka steps beneath the light Like a riot dressed for Saturday night

Poster child for “Do Not Trust” Red-tagged name in city dust Every anthem, every stage Another file marked CONTAIN THIS RAGE

[Pre-Chorus] They watch the doors They track the crowd They write my name in letters loud

But all they’ve really done so far Is give my anger a brighter mark

[Chorus] This is the color of rage Red on the file, fire on the stage If you want me quiet You came too late

They stamped my name Now I stampede your gate

The color of rage Say it to my face You can keep me Red But you can’t keep me in place

[Verse] My bloodline built some of these halls Before your polished protocol Founding Kin with heavy names Now I’m the branch you couldn’t tame

Family gone in a single night One bad “accident,” one missing light No one proved a thing at all But I learned quick how empires fall

Microphones and busted strings Became my knives, became my wings If I can’t crack your walls apart I’ll teach the city where the cracks all are

[Pre-Chorus] They say, “Rikka, show some grace” I say, “Grace is not my lane” If the truth comes out distorted Turn it up and play again

[Chorus] This is the color of rage Red on the file, fire on the stage If you want me quiet You came too late

They stamped my name Now I stampede your gate

The color of rage Say it to my face You can keep me Red But you can’t keep me in place

[Bridge] Every show, another warning Every lyric, another threat Every suit in every office Wishes I were easier to forget

But the crowd knows every word now Every alley knows my sound And the more they try to flag me The more the city turns around

They can’t Black me Can’t erase me Can’t disappear what my family made So they did the only thing they could

Painted me Red

And prayed

[Break] Company line Corporate smile Institutional parasite

Color code Control the Kin Dress the wound and call it discipline

I see the fear beneath your power Hear it shake behind the lie

If the system was so righteous Why’s it terrified of one girl with a mic?

[Pre-Chorus] They keep me close They keep me marked They keep me just outside the dark

Because if I fall past Red The capital might ask who lit the spark

[Chorus] This is the color of rage Red on the file, fire on the stage If you want me quiet You came too late

They stamped my name Now I stampede your gate

The color of rage Say it to my face You can keep me Red But you can’t keep me in place

[Final Chorus] This is the color of rage And I wear it like a battle paint Not your warning Not your shame Not the leash you hoped would make me safe

The color of rage Let the whole city shake If your order needs my silence Then your order was a mistake

The color of rage Louder every day You can brand me all you want

I’ll just turn your mark Into a flag

And make the crowd sing my name

[Outro] One more chord One more scream One more anthem split at the seams

Capital skyline Red-lit haze

Rikka grins Steps to the mic

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“You gave me a color.”

“So I made it louder.”
